# in the same coordinates. x* = (x - x_0) / L_int, x_0 the mean position of the ideal incident shock (the nominal impingement point), L_int
# from it to the foot of the reflected shock: the convention of sbli_oracle.py. (The authors' footnote: in Dupont et al. x_0 is the mean
# position of the reflected shock, so their x* differs by one, the positions being the same.)
